title: Puttering Puzzlepuff
statement: A thumb-sized puffer with an apricot belly and midnight-blue freckles putters through tea-green water, steering with fins like tiny transparent fans. Beneath a single amber light, its tank holds smooth slate arches, ribbonlike plants, and white pebbles it patiently arranges into spirals—though whenever a spiral is finished, it steals one stone to start something else.
